expected_identity: Semantic goldens omit alert.id; identity has independent engine tests and native replay must preserve it.

cases.name: write_then_matching_request
cases.reason: A successful create and exact resource request share host, filesystem namespace and canonical path.

cases.name: benign_deploy_ordinary_dynamic_page
cases.reason: A normal PHP page requested after deployment lacks every selected query key.

cases.name: benign_static_upload
cases.reason: An uploaded image is outside the configured script-like suffix set, even with cmd as a query key.

cases.name: benign_admin_cmd_after_deploy
cases.reason: A legitimate administrative page deployed then called with cmd satisfies the same candidate condition; this is a known benign match.

cases.name: different_filesystem_namespace
cases.reason: Two containers may expose the same absolute path on one host; their namespace IDs must prevent a join.

cases.name: mapped_aliases_same_physical_resource
cases.reason: Trusted upstream mapping identifies the same physical file despite different presentation aliases; neither raw Host nor the alias is a join key.

cases.name: different_host
cases.reason: Identical namespace and path strings on another host must not join.

cases.name: different_path
cases.reason: The request must name the exact file path, not merely the same directory or extension.

cases.name: posix_path_case_is_significant
cases.reason: POSIX path spelling remains case-sensitive.

cases.name: webroot_prefix_is_not_descendant
cases.reason: A shared text prefix does not place the file beneath /var/www/html.

cases.name: failed_write_does_not_qualify
cases.reason: A reported failed operation is not a successful create/write.

cases.name: open_for_write_intent_is_not_write
cases.reason: A successful open or write-intent event does not establish the required successful create/write normalization.

cases.name: request_without_file_evidence
cases.reason: A suspicious-looking request alone is insufficient; pre-existing files are outside this sequence.

cases.name: request_before_file
cases.reason: A request before the file event cannot be linked causally.

cases.name: equal_timestamp_is_inclusive
cases.reason: The lower endpoint includes equal normalized timestamps, without claiming a finer order within that timestamp.

cases.name: exact_window_end_is_excluded
cases.reason: A request exactly 300 seconds after the file event is outside the half-open window.

cases.name: one_microsecond_inside_window
cases.reason: A request one microsecond before the upper endpoint remains eligible.

cases.name: latest_eligible_write_is_selected
cases.reason: Out-of-order delivery selects the most recent successful eligible write, emitting one alert per HTTP event.

cases.name: file_timestamp_tie_uses_largest_id
cases.reason: Equal file timestamps choose the lexicographically greatest event ID deterministically.

cases.name: equivalent_timezone_redelivery
cases.reason: Equivalent timestamps and unchanged IDs deduplicate without generating extra candidates.

cases.name: once_encoded_query_key
cases.reason: One UTF-8 percent-decoding pass exposes an exact cmd key.

cases.name: double_encoding_is_not_decoded_twice
cases.reason: A twice-encoded spelling is outside the explicit single-decoding contract.

cases.name: query_substrings_are_not_keys
cases.reason: Neither a larger parameter name nor text inside a value is an exact selected key.

cases.name: query_key_case_is_significant
cases.reason: Query keys use exact case; application-specific case folding is not inferred.

cases.name: empty_and_bare_keys_are_candidates
cases.reason: The selector checks key presence, including blank values; it does not claim a command value was present or executed.

cases.name: selected_query_keys_sorted_and_deduplicated
cases.reason: Repeated query keys do not duplicate alerts and evidence lists exact selected keys once.

cases.name: custom_window_excludes_endpoint
cases.reason: An explicit 60-second window excludes its endpoint.

cases.name: bounded_replay_retains_file_context
cases.reason: Only request anchors in [A,B) emit; the file at A-W+1us is required context and the floor/end events must not affect the result.

cases.name: repeated_requests_preserve_each_evidence_pair
cases.reason: Two distinct qualifying HTTP events each retain their own file/request evidence pair; this is not alert suppression.

cases.name: failed_later_write_does_not_hide_success
cases.reason: The latest eligible successful write is used; a later failed operation does not establish replacement file contents.

cases.name: http_404_is_request_evidence_only
cases.reason: A 404 request still satisfies the observed sequence; the result never claims successful execution or that the file still exists.

cases.name: uppercase_suffix_preserves_exact_path
cases.reason: Suffix recognition is case-insensitive but full paths remain exact; a script-like filename does not establish server handler configuration.

cases.name: unconfigured_phtml_suffix_is_outside_pilot
cases.reason: This pilot declares only php/jsp/aspx suffixes; broader Sigma or web-server handler support is not inherited.

cases.name: missing_resource_namespace
cases.reason: A missing filesystem namespace cannot silently fall back to host/path.

cases.name: string_success_flag
cases.reason: A string must not be coerced to the required boolean success flag.

cases.name: noncanonical_resource_path
cases.reason: Join keys must already be canonical; lexical traversal is not resolved by the detector.

cases.name: malformed_query_escape
cases.reason: Malformed raw query escapes fail explicitly instead of creating an uncertain key match.

cases.name: numeric_namespace
cases.reason: A numeric namespace must not become a keyword through Elasticsearch coercion.

cases.name: control_character_event_identity
cases.reason: Control characters in source identities are rejected before constructing alert identity.

cases.name: conflicting_event_redelivery
cases.reason: A changed payload under one immutable source event ID must fail, not choose one version.
